changes: A jack in ACTION mode with ACTION OFF is no longer read in the audio interrupt, and with no jack in ACTION mode the ev_render_out handler is a two-byte test; on the author's unit, both jacks at ACTION OFF, the handler costs 0.8 µs a block instead of 3.6 µs. A jack with an action is read as in 0.1.1, and actions play unchanged.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
